name: Kingdom of Poland and Grand Duchy of Lithuania
summary: The medieval Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, joined by a personal union in 1386 under the Jagiellonian dynasty, before forming the Commonwealth in 1569.

knownFor.label: Battle of Grunwald
knownFor.note: Poland and Lithuania defeated the Teutonic Knights.

knownFor.label: Jagiellonian University
knownFor.note: Founded in Kraków; Copernicus studied there.

location.value: Poland, Lithuania, Belarus and much of Ukraine.
